description: Synthetic triage helpers and envelope parity from pinned sesslint.triage.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-triage-get-profile: triage() calls sesslint.profiles.get_profile before any ledger work. Rust stops with sesslint.profiles.get_profile is not available and does not return TriageReport.
GAP-triage-preview: _preview reads sesslint.assessment.SourceAssessment and calls plan. Rust preview() stops with sesslint.assessment.SourceAssessment is not available.

GAP-triage-read-codex-state: _native_state after copy guards calls sesslint.state_db.read_codex_state and may return membership-matches or membership-mismatch. Rust native_state() stops with sesslint.state_db.read_codex_state is not available.
